mentions.name: Acoust
mentions.description: This web product at acoust.io began as a project to learn React and has since gained a few customers after being posted on Reddit; the builder is still working out its positioning in a crowded market.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://acoust.io began as a project to learn React. However, I received a few customers after posting it on Reddit. I’m still figuring out the best way to position it in the crowded market, but I’m enjoying the process of building and learning.
